source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1

source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1

source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1

source_segments.text: Someone spends time describing the colour of the rail. Its paint is chipped near the wheel but the rail still rolls. This conversation is about the storage furniture, not permission to borrow the seven damaged coats.

source_segments.speaker: Speaker 2

source_segments.text: The costume designer considers a different hanger for two heavy coats. The current hangers will remain unless the designer supplies replacements before packing. No extra purchase is added to the transport agreement.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 3

source_segments.text: A note says that photographs may be used internally to identify which coat is in each bag. It gives no permission to post performers’ names, personal measurements or fitting photographs on social media.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 3

source_segments.text: The final packing list must contain 17 coats and leave the seven repairs at the store. If the release is not signed on time, the vehicle booking will be moved and the costumes will remain in storage.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 3

source_segments.text: Nothing was handed over today. Luca will report whether any repairs can be completed later, but no later repair has been promised for this production and the agreed loan still covers only the 17 inspected coats.
source_segments.speaker: Speaker 1
